title: 전자제품 매장에서: 어느 게 더 가벼워요?
objective: You can ask which product is lighter, cheaper, or bigger with 어느 게 더 ...?, and use -고요 to add one more point.
summary: A customer compares two laptops and learns to ask 어느 게 더 ...? and add details with -고요.
setting: An electronics store. A customer wants a laptop and compares two models with a clerk.

task.title: Compare and choose
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to choose, fill in, arrange, or answer in Korean.

words.exampleMeaning: I like the white one better.

words.meaning: the most (the top one of all)
to be cheap, low in price
I'll take this one (choosing an item)

dialogue.meaning: I'd like to look at some laptops.

dialogue.korean: 이쪽으로 오세요. 이 노트북이 더 가볍고요, 배터리도 오래가요.
dialogue.meaning: This way, please. This laptop is lighter, and the battery lasts long too.
What about the one next to it?

dialogue.korean: 그건 조금 무겁고요, 화면이 더 커요.
dialogue.meaning: That one is a little heavier, and the screen is bigger.
The one with the bigger screen is cheaper.

dialogue.korean: 음, 가벼운 게 더 좋아요. 이걸로 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Hmm, I like the light one better. I'll take this one.

exercises: Fill in the blank to add one more point: 이 태블릿은 화면이 크____, 소리도 좋아요.
Choose the right word: ① 이 노트북은 1kg이에요. 저 노트북은 2kg이에요. 이 노트북이 더 (가벼워요 / 무거워요). ② TV가 세 개 있어요. 이 TV가 화면이 (더 / 제일) 커요.
Put the words in order to make a question: 가벼워요 / 게 / 더 / 어느
Answer from the dialogue: 어느 노트북이 더 싸요?
Answer in Korean: You want the black one (black = 검은색). Tell the clerk.
